protocol_type: Character-and-packet serial link protocol over LVDS with Data-Strobe encoding. The link is brought up by the exchange-level state machine (ErrorReset -> ErrorWait -> Ready -> Started -> Connecting -> Run) exchanging NULLs and FCTs; once in Run, data characters flow under credit-based flow control inside packets delimited by EOP/EEP, forwarded across a network by routers using wormhole routing.

protocol_levels.name: Signal
protocol_levels.purpose: LVDS signalling and Data-Strobe (DS) encoding; clock = Data XOR Strobe.

protocol_levels.name: Character
protocol_levels.purpose: 10-bit data characters and 4-bit control characters (FCT/EOP/EEP/ESC; NULL; Time-Code).

protocol_levels.name: Exchange
protocol_levels.purpose: Link initialization state machine, flow control, link error detection and recovery.

protocol_levels.name: Network
protocol_levels.purpose: Routers, wormhole routing, and addressing across a SpaceWire network.

character_types.name: Data character
character_types.fields: parity + data-control flag (=0) + 8 data bits (LSB first)

control_characters.name: FCT
control_characters.purpose: Grants credit to send eight further N-Chars.

control_characters.name: EOP
control_characters.purpose: Marks the normal end of a packet.

control_characters.name: EEP
control_characters.purpose: Marks a premature end of a packet due to a network error.

control_characters.name: ESC
control_characters.purpose: Forms longer codes with the following character (NULL = ESC+FCT; Time-Code = ESC + data character).

composite_codes.name: NULL
composite_codes.purpose: Sent when nothing else is to be sent; keeps the link active and confirms the connection.

composite_codes.name: Time-Code
composite_codes.purpose: Carries a 6-bit time value plus two flags for system-time distribution.

character_classes.N-Char: Normal characters passed to the host: data characters, EOP, EEP.
character_classes.L-Char: Link characters consumed by the link interface: FCT, ESC, NULL, Time-Codes.

link_initialization.handshake: ErrorReset (reset ~6.4 us) -> ErrorWait (~12.8 us) -> Ready (wait for enable) -> Started (send NULLs, wait for a NULL) -> Connecting (send FCTs, wait for an FCT) -> Run (full operation).
link_initialization.synchronization: Both ends exchange NULLs to confirm the link is connected and FCTs to confirm credit before data flows.

flow_control.rule: Each received FCT adds eight to the credit; each N-Char transmitted subtracts one; an N-Char may be sent only when credit > 0.

packet_format.address: path address (port numbers), logical address (one byte), or regional-logical address.

addressing.path: Leading data character is an output port number (1..31), consumed (deleted) by each router.
addressing.logical: Leading data character is a logical address (32..255) mapped to an output port by the router's routing table; not deleted.
addressing.regional_logical: Combination of path and logical addressing for large networks.
addressing.group_adaptive: A logical address may map to a group of output ports for load sharing and redundancy.

time_codes.rule: Each node/router forwards a Time-Code whose value is one greater (modulo 64) than the last and signals a tick to its host.
